slides.title: What Happened
slides.body: Nvidia said on Nov 12 that Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and left its board. The filing says the board accepted it on Nov 11. A search for a permanent CEO has begun.

slides.title: Who Is in Charge Now
slides.body: Colette Kress, CFO since 2013, will lead on an interim basis. Harvey Jones, a director since 1993, was named board chair. The board will weigh internal and outside candidates.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Nvidia is a bellwether for AI spending and a heavyweight in major stock indexes. CBS reported its shares closed down 4.3% on Nov 12, at $166.19.
